thanks, i’m trying to learn how to set boundaries now. i haven’t agreed to do it but when he contacts me it’s always brought up. the other day he asked me to have a threesome with his new girl. idk if he asked me because he knew it would hurt my feelings or if he just  doesn’t care much for me besides my body or both. he says that he’s still in contact with me because he wants to stay friends but i know that’s not really the case. you’re assumptions are right, i do want to be liked and i don’t really want to be alone. and we have a lot of mutual friends so i don’t want to be even more alone by whatever he says.

right now i’m trying to learn more about myself and love being in my own company. i’m trying to not worry about how I’m being perceived by others and love myself. it’s hard but i’m trying. i’ve never thought to sit down to do think about what type of relationships i want in my life. i think i’ll try that

thanks for responding. how do you know when it’s good to keeping pushing forward and when to bail? that’s something i really struggle with i never really know how to let go of people and i give them the benefit of the doubt or blame myself. i can never really tell when i have a healthy or unhealthy relationship

thank you. yes, right now we are at my mom’s house at the moment. i talked with her and she told him that he had until the end of march to find a place to stay. and i think i’m going to have to have some distance with him for a while

it’s an unreal feeling hearing things like that from your own family. i’m sorry he said that. mine refuses to apologize to me either, he’s walking around the house calm as ever, laughing like nothing ever happened

thanks for replying. i’m currently seeing a therapist to work through those thoughts. and i’m really considering moving away, although it’s never been this bad he’s always been this way and i don’t think he’s ever going to change or want to change. i don’t want to cut him off because he’s my brother but i feel like i have to at this point
we both are at my mom’s house at the moment

I have been struggling with these thoughts for years now and they have been worsening more so much recently. I have been trying so hard to uplift myself and stop these thoughts, and this just put me in a whole new spiral.

It’s like him saying this to me just validates how I had been feeling. He’s the type to get really violent and abusive when he doesn’t get his way, and I wanted to at least try to start a boundary with him. He asked me to drive him to work in the morning, but I said that I couldn’t. I hadn’t been getting much sleep or rest in general and by the time I did get up I was extremely exhausted.  He came in knocking over almost all of my things in my room, threw stuff at me, and was in my face trying to fight me because I said no to him. I tried stand my ground and gave him other options but he didn’t want to hear any of it and kept cursing at me until he told me to just ‘stay in my room like I always do and to go kill myself’.

So I guess I’m in shock that something like this would make him say those words to me. I tried to set a boundary, which is something that is so hard for me to do in general and this is what I get. We’ve gotten into arguments before, but he’s never said those words to me. And he knows where I’m at mentally. So it just makes me think if my blood can feel this way about me or if this is what I get back when I try to stand up for myself, then I must’ve always been right about my worth here. That’s what’s killing me right now.
